title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-a4n2.3: missing tx_queue_destroy in lichen_link_cleanup leaks POSIX mutex
description:
Commit 1a774fce5 adds tx_queue to struct lichen_link_ctx and calls tx_queue_init() in lichen_link_init() (link_ctx.c:186), but does NOT call tx_queue_destroy() in lichen_link_cleanup() (link_ctx.c:572-597).

Impact:
- On POSIX/Linux: pthread_mutex_t inside tx_queue is never destroyed, causing a mutex resource leak on every cleanup. Worse, if cleanup is followed by re-init (common in enable/disable cycles), tx_queue_init() re-initializes the mutex without destroying first, which is undefined behavior per POSIX.
- On Zephyr: tx_queue_destroy is a no-op, so no issue.

Fix: Add tx_queue_destroy(&ctx->tx_queue) at the start of lichen_link_cleanup(), before the seq_lock destroy.
